tools.name: get_tweet
tools.description: Get caption, author, and media download links for a public X post.

tools.name: get_network_identity
tools.description: Where this user's requests to the site leave from (a VPN country, the server, or the app's default) and which browser they present. Read-only.

tools.name: set_network_identity
tools.description: Choose where this user's requests to the site leave from and which browser they present, only when the user asks (e.g. 'connect through Nigeria', 'use my own user agent'). Sites may ask the user to sign in again when this changes. reset=true goes back to how they signed in.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-bgpt-tweet-downloader" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tweet · Public sink: get_tweet · Destructive: set_network_identity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tweet · Public sink: get_tweet · Destructive: set_network_identity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
